crossRefs.note: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the…

translations.web: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
translations.bsb: But in order not to delay you any further, I beg your indulgence to hear us briefly.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
translations.asv: But, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I entreat thee to hear us of thy clemency a few words.
